title: Product Launch Microlearning
summary: A sanitized sales-enablement case study built as two connected launch assets: a concise positioning overview and a separate scenario-based practice experience, with a sanitized replacement learner sample.

content.business_need: Give sellers enough launch context to explain a new offer and recognize customer fit without turning a focused product introduction into a full certification course.
content.audience: Internal sellers and channel partners who need quick launch readiness before customer conversations.
learning_objectives: Explain the customer problem and product value at a sales-ready level.
Recognize common situations where the offer may fit.
Practice choosing an appropriate customer-facing response or next step.
Use supporting launch resources without memorizing unnecessary detail.
content.role: Instructional designer and developer responsible for learning structure, scenario design, build, review coordination, and revision.
content.design_approach: Separate context from practice instead of compressing everything into one long module. Use the short overview for positioning and use cases, then give sellers a focused scenario where choices and explanatory feedback rehearse the customer conversation.
content.development_process: Translated approved launch and product-marketing material into a Rise overview and a separate Storyline practice experience, then coordinated internal QA and SME review through Review 360 and Asana. Revisions focused on instructions, readability, navigation, feedback, and completion messaging.
outcomes: Delivered a paired learn-then-practice experience rather than an oversized launch course.
Used scenario decisions and explanatory feedback to move beyond passive product review.
Kept the two assets modular so positioning content and practice could be revised independently as launch guidance changed.

source_material_notes: Generalized from documented product-launch enablement work. Product names, launch messaging, internal screenshots, customer details, reviewer comments, dates, links, and proprietary source material are intentionally omitted.
